description: Returns the published availability of one District workspace: whether it is available now, available from a date, on request or unavailable, whether the operator has confirmed it in the last 21 days, how many desks it holds, and its published price. Optional inputs: desks (the team size), to learn whether it holds them, and startMonth (YYYY-MM), to learn whether it is free in time. This is the operator's published availability, the same as the District listing page shows. available_now means the operator lists it as available and no let, hold or unavailability covers today; it is not a statement that the operator checked it recently, so read verification (confirmed, none or not_verified). on_request means to ask the operator about your dates. requestViewingUrl is the District listing page, where viewings are requested. Read only: it cannot book, enquire or show contact details.

desks.description: Team size, to check the listing holds them

startMonth.description: Month the team wants to move in, as YYYY-MM

name: get_availability

availabilityConfirmed.description: True only when verification is confirmed

availableFrom.description: First day an occupier could move in (YYYY-MM-DD), when known

confirmedAt.description: When the operator last confirmed it (ISO), only while verification is confirmed, else null

confirmedUntil.description: When that confirmation's 21 days end (ISO), only while verification is confirmed, else null

meetsStartMonth.description: True if in time for the start month asked, false if not, null if no month was asked or it is on request

notVerifiedFrom.description: When not_verified starts or started (ISO), or null

status.description: available_now: the operator lists it as available and no let, hold or unavailability covers today. This is not a statement that the operator checked it recently; read verification. on_request: ask the operator about your dates

verification.description: confirmed: the operator confirmed it is available in the last 21 days. not_verified: the operator has not verified it in the last 30 days. none: neither, which says nothing against the listing. Only an office that reads available_now carries confirmed or not_verified

fits.description: Whether it holds the desks asked; null when none were asked

requestViewingUrl.description: The District listing page, where viewings are requested

title: Check District Availability
